en.title: Maximum Target Values After Adding One Integer to a Range
en.description:
Choose a contiguous range at most once and add the same arbitrary integer x to every number in it, maximizing the number of elements in the whole array equal to k. x may be negative or 0, and you may also skip the operation.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k; the second line contains the array. 1≤n≤200000; 1≤element,k≤200000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
hints: If some v≠k is turned into k, each v in the window gains +1, each original k gains −1, and other values gain 0. For each v, keep the best segment gain as of its last occurrence and the cumulative count of k at that time; lazily subtract the k values in between using the cumulative difference, then run Kadane with restarts.
